EmailTemplate.subject: MQL has not been Contacted.
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Lead.OwnerFirstName},
The lead you own {!Lead.Name} from {!Lead.Company} in the MQL Stage, with priority of {!Lead.Core_Lead_Priority__c} has not responded to your contact attempts and is 21 days old.
Click here to visit this lead record in SFDC
Please process your lead by updating the Lead Status and Sub Status as soon as possible. If you have followed the 'New Contact Policy' and have attempted 12 activities to contact, then please disposition the Lead.
Leads move to a terminated state if there is no activity for 30 days and 90 days since the creation date.
Thank you.
